Technical support to define the institutional concept of “Positive Impact” and its assessment methodology. Project activities include the construction of environmental and social indicators to measure the positive impacts generated by the bank's sustainability projects; the development of an indicator tracking tool (dashboard); the construction of the assessment methodology; and the implementation of a pilot program to test the methodology.
